items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Evelyn Johnson, his secretary had contacted me and I told her yes

ctx.x: bought some dates on Sam Cooke, twelve or fifteen, and he wanted a band to back him and somehow or another my name came up and Evelyn Johnson, his secretary had contacted me and I told her yes. I had done work for them before but after all, they wanted to get their own opinion, and they said something to Sam Cooke, did he know anything about Ernie Fields' band and Sam said, not particularly, but Rene used to be in his band, maybe he could say something, but that was years ago.

So they gave Rene Hall a call and wanted to know did he think Ernie Field's band could play Sam Cooke's music. Rene turned (inaudible). To tell you the truth, I don't know what Ernie has, but if he has a band, he'll play his book.
